The supraspinatus tendon is most commonly involved, but the infraspinatus, teres minor, and subscapularis tendons can also be torn. • Defining whether a rotator cuff tear is acute has relevance to treatment. In evaluating individuals, the surgeon should attempt to properly identify individuals with acute tears as opposed to individuals with pre-existing chronic tears that become symptomatic after an injury event. A discrete traumatic event is more suggestive of acute tear.
